mentions.name: Ampr
mentions.description: A backend platform for EV chargers and charging networks, aiming to be the Parse/Firebase/Stripe equivalent for the EV charging space so developers don't have to grapple with the messy tech side of charging infrastructure.
mentions.problem: The tech side of EV charging is a mess, requiring significant effort to integrate chargers and networks until a ready-made backend exists.
mentions.audience: EV charging firms and developers integrating with chargers and charging networks
mentions.source_excerpt:
realised the tech side is such a mess, though of doing a Parse/Firebase/Stripe for EV chargers and networks.

So people don't need to lose braincells over this till it actually matters.

https://ampr.dev/
